cells.claim: Pure provisioning logic is deterministic; depth contracts are added red-first
The built CLI and fragmented local HTTP boundaries cover bounded acquisition, timeout, truncation, response variants, stream cleanup, envelope parsing, and bounded QuickLZ decoding
Tracked Rust sources are formatted and warning-free
Pinned native Cargo resolution denies crates.io versions younger than seven days and the complete lockfile passes an independent age audit

cells.environment: Ubuntu 24.04 with pinned Rust mutation tool
cells.claim: All 40 viable depth-stream/profile/scale, all 28 viable frame-envelope, all 38 viable depth-decoder/Z16, all 53 viable calibration, and all 41 viable ROS mapping mutants are caught; surviving HTTP and ROS runtime-adapter mutants remain open
Five consecutive real-hardware runs each configured depth output, captured exactly 1048576 live bytes, closed the stream, and restarted successfully

The Rust client recovered and QuickLZ-decompressed four complete bounded envelopes; each became an owned little-endian Z16 plane exactly matching the explicitly selected 640x400 profile and 1280-byte stride

cells.environment: POP 3 Plus and measured physical targets
cells.claim: The device reports 0.1 mm per Z16 unit; its 1280x800 depth projection record parses and scales to the selected 640x400 stream as the public SDK specifies; physical-target, distortion, rectification, and invalid-value qualification remain open
Stock Jazzy subscribers received live 640x400 sensor_msgs/Image 32FC1-meter and rectified CameraInfo topics with sensor-data QoS and per-pair matching headers

cells.command: ros2 run depth_image_proc point_cloud_xyz_node --ros-args -r image_rect:=/depth/image_rect -r camera_info:=/depth/camera_info
cells.claim: Stock depth_image_proc synchronized the live driver topics and emitted a non-empty organized 640x400 PointCloud2

cells.environment: POP 3 Plus, turntable, ROS 2 Jazzy, RViz2
cells.claim: RViz2 rendered the real live organized cloud against a metric grid; recognizable-object shape, turntable motion, orientation, and measured scale/planarity remain unqualified
